observations: One DP row allocated on shorter Unicode-scalar string; full inner iterator restarts without byte indexing. Unit substitution/insertion/deletion recurrence, empty inputs and no normalization inspected.
No external crates, unsafe, IO, network, process execution or top-level executable effects. Original MIT authors match accompanying LICENSE.
Not grapheme distance, unbounded caller inputs can be expensive; no performance/production or upstream certification.
Pinned right12/left25/right27 uint64 wrapping transform retained; zero scores and earliest-current-order ties handled.
New validates all names before caller hashing and copies supplied names. Add rejects invalid names without mutation/hash; hashes once before insertion.

Only standard errors dependency; no IO, subprocess, unsafe, network, initialization effects. Full MIT attribution retained.
Hasher is caller code: must be deterministic and non-reentrant; errors/panics from user hash not contained. Construct with New, single-thread/process-local, no distribution/concurrency guarantees.
